shortDescription: Module for setup of DynamicDnsRecord Avi RESTful Object

options.name: algorithm
options.description: Specifies the algorithm to pick the ip address(es) to be returned,when multiple entries are configured. This does not apply if num_records_in_response is 0. Default is round-robin. Enum options - DNS_RECORD_RESPONSE_ROUND_ROBIN, DNS_RECORD_RESPONSE_CONSISTENT_HASH. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as DNS_RECORD_RESPONSE_ROUND_ROBIN.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cname
options.description: Canonical name in cname record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: delegated
options.description: Configured fqdns are delegated domains (i.e. They represent a zone cut). Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: description
options.description: Details of dns record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dns_vs_uuid
options.description: Uuid of the dns vs. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: fqdn
options.description: Fully qualified domain name. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ip6_address
options.description: Ipv6 address in aaaa record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Maximum of 4 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: Ip address in a record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Maximum of 4 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: metadata
options.description: Internal metadata for the dns record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: mx_records
options.description: Mx record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Maximum of 4 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Dynamicdnsrecord name, needed for a top level uuid protobuf, for display in shell. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ns
options.description: Name server information in ns record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Maximum of 13 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: num_records_in_response
options.description: Specifies the number of records returned by the dns service.enter 0 to return all records. Default is 0. Allowed values are 0-20. Special values are 0- return all records. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: service_locators
options.description: Service locator info in srv record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Maximum of 4 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant_uuid from dns vss tenant_uuid. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Time to live for this dns record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: txt_records
options.description: Text record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Maximum of 4 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: type
options.description: Dns record type. Enum options - DNS_RECORD_OTHER, DNS_RECORD_A, DNS_RECORD_NS, DNS_RECORD_CNAME, DNS_RECORD_SOA, DNS_RECORD_PTR, DNS_RECORD_HINFO, DNS_RECORD_MX, DNS_RECORD_TXT, DNS_RECORD_RP, DNS_RECORD_DNSKEY, DNS_RECORD_AAAA, DNS_RECORD_SRV, DNS_RECORD_OPT, DNS_RECORD_RRSIG, DNS_RECORD_AXFR, DNS_RECORD_ANY. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the dns record. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: wildcard_match
options.description: Enable wild-card match of fqdn  if an exact match is not found in the dns table, the longest match is chosen by wild-carding the fqdn in the dns request. Default is false. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.
